name: MeasureTheory.Measure.tilted
type: {α : Type u} → {mα : MeasurableSpace α} → MeasureTheory.Measure α → (α → ℝ) → MeasureTheory.Measure α
provides: Exponentially tilted measure with density exp(f) divided by its integral; for nonzero base measure and integrable exp(f) it is a probability law, and nonintegrability gives the zero measure.
